topics.title: Stern Discusses Simmons’ Naked Hug and Fat Bro Obsession
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Howard Stern discusses Richard Simmons being hugged by a naked woman, Jackie’s fascination with ‘fat bros,’ and speculation about Simmons' discomfort around physical contact. The conversation shifts to concerns regarding Simmons’ attractiveness and its potential impact on his interactions.

topics.title: State Fair Musings
topics.summary: During a radio segment, Howard discusses his plans for exercising people at the New Jersey State Fair while judging livestock. He engages in lighthearted banter with listeners about various topics including Jeep ownership, celebrity impressions (Charles Nelson Riley), and perceived eccentricities of attendees, culminating in an awkward exchange regarding finger counts.

topics.title: Richard Simmons Reveals Shocking Claims
topics.summary: During a radio segment, Richard Simmons discusses bizarre encounters including claims of being spanked by a gay hustler and his fondness for muscular men. He details his cruise to lose weight, critiques the media’s portrayal of him, and engages in increasingly absurd conversations about personal preferences and celebrity gossip.”} 39 words

topics.title: Explicit Sex Calls and a Jewish Hustler
topics.summary: A radio host facilitates an explicit conversation about arranging spanking sessions with multiple male companions, including a gay hustler named Simmons who receives $3200 daily for the service. The discussion quickly veers into bizarre scenarios involving movie watching, identity confusion, accusations of Jewish control within entertainment, and personal anxieties regarding Richard's lifestyle.

topics.title: Stern’s Wild Guessing Game – Jude Nelson Edition
topics.summary: Howard and his co-hosts engage in a chaotic game attempting to identify celebrities based on vague descriptions, including misidentifying Michael Landon as Jewish due to stereotypes. The segment devolves into conversations about past guests like Sam Kinison's sobriety and attempts to book David Brenner for a show, culminating with Kurt Waldheim Jr.’s appearance.”} <start_of_image>\n 201 words.

topics.title: Stern Addresses Press in Los Angeles
topics.summary: Howard Stern held a press conference amidst continued media hostility, dismissing concerns about negative coverage and expressing frustration with former co-hosts Mark & Brian. He announced plans to address fans directly after an outdoor event featuring Gary dressed as a hunchback while also discussing sales figures for his video.
